target.title: Cleanup policy is documented
target.test: Repository documentation should describe the monorepo cleanup boundaries so stale root src, dist, tests, and runtime volume contents do not reappear.

steps.expected: docs/testing.md states that test/ is the authoritative path and tests/ must not be used.
Documentation records that source lives under apps/* and packages/ndx and root src/dist are not source-owned paths.

target.passCriteria: Docs clearly distinguish source, test policy, and generated cleanup boundaries.

target.expected: docs/testing.md states that test/ is the authoritative path and tests/ must not be used.

steps.descript: Testing docs now record the test/ policy and generated artifact boundaries.
evidence: docs/testing.md contains: Use test/YYYYMMDD/HHMMSS_*.json for suites.
docs/testing.md contains: Do not create or restore root tests/, tests/plans, or tests/reports.
docs/testing.md documents root dist, .turbo, .yarn/unplugged, .yarn/install-state.gz, and Docker volume cleanup boundaries.

target.expected: Documentation records that source lives under apps/* and packages/ndx and root src/dist are not source-owned paths.

steps.descript: Internals docs now distinguish workspace source roots from stale root paths.
evidence: docs/internals.md states root src, root dist, and root tests are not source-owned monorepo paths.
docs/internals.md states source belongs under apps/*/src or packages/ndx/src.
docs/usage.md path-mapping example now uses test/20260507 instead of tests/reports.

result.descript: Docs distinguish active monorepo source/test paths from removable leftovers.
evidence: docs/testing.md and docs/internals.md were updated with cleanup policy.
docs/usage.md no longer points examples at tests/reports.
